title: Test a business idea in 48 hours before you build it
topic: Testing a business idea in 48 hours with free AI tools before spending money
target_audience: Aspiring founders with an idea but no proof
audience_problem: They're scared to spend money or months on an idea nobody wants

beats.voiceover: Before you build anything, run this 48-hour test.
beats.visual: Talking head, timer graphic '48:00' counting down in the corner.

beats.voiceover: Most people spend weeks building something before checking that anyone actually wants it.
beats.visual: Calendar pages flipping quickly, then a blank 'orders' screen.

beats.voiceover: First, ask an AI chatbot for your customer's ten biggest frustrations. Then check them against real reviews.
beats.visual: Screen recording: typing the prompt into a chatbot, then scrolling public reviews (blur names).

beats.voiceover: Next, make a one-page offer. One problem, one promise, one price.
beats.visual: Screen recording of a simple one-page site being edited in a free website builder.

beats.voiceover: Then send it to ten people who fit, and ask them to join a waitlist or book a call.
beats.visual: Phone screen sending a short message; counter ticks 1 to 10.

beats.voiceover: If nobody's interested, you've lost two days, not two months. If a few say yes, you've got a reason to keep going.
beats.visual: Side-by-side: '2 days' vs '2 months' with the second crossed out.

beats.voiceover: Save this for your next idea.
beats.on_screen_text: Save this for your next idea
beats.visual: Point to the save icon, friendly nod.

instagram.caption:
Don't build first. Test first.

The 48-hour test:
1. Ask AI for your customer's biggest frustrations, then check them against real reviews
2. Make a one-page offer: one problem, one promise, one price
3. Send it to 10 people who fit and ask them to join a waitlist or book a call

A test won't guarantee success, but it can save you months.
